source: The {0} prop is an {1} that may also carry {2}, {3}, {4}, {5} and {6}. A server-side error is always a {7}, so the fields exist, though {8}, {9} and {10} are {11} when Nuxt does not know them. An error thrown on the client is passed through as it was thrown, so the fields are only present when the thrown error carried them, for example an error created with {12}.
